status_line: DRAFT for the owner's approval. Nothing has been trained.
label: Version 8, near-80: the main test's setting with every recorded throttle from 70% to 90% also hidden
approvable_note: A draft cannot be approved. After the owner answers the choices, the session writes the final prereg.json, the code manifest and approve_local_near80.py; the owner approves that fingerprint.

request.comment: what about the values close to 80%. I think they should be deliberately left out of the training data and introduced during testing so we can really see OOD
request.offer: the main test's setting with a band around 80% removed as well (for example thruster 1's throttles from 70% to 90%)

question: When the good commands just below the 80% stall are hidden from training, does BCA still let the controller use them while keeping it from going past 80%, and does it do better than simply staying inside the recorded data?

band.comparison: |a_k| at the exact float64 value of the stored float32 command against the float64 numbers 0.70 and 0.90 (shift.Gap.contains' convention). float32(0.7) = 0.699999988 is outside, float32(0.9) = 0.899999976 inside.
band.rule: a row is in the band when 0.70 <= |a_k| <= 0.90 for at least one thruster k

removal_combination.rule: ball OR band: shift.make_removal(log, 'gap', gap) first (bit for bit), then every band row
removal_combination.input_normalization: the gate's: from the ball-kept training rows' observations (states only), as step 1
removal_combination.what_it_adds_on_seeds_0_4: after the ball, (0.80, 0.90] is already empty on every seed and world, so the band adds only throttles from 0.70 to 0.80: normal driving just below the stall

random_rows_control.rule: the ball, then, in each kind of water (calm, hard water), exactly as many extra training rows as the band removes there, drawn uniformly from the ball-kept training rows of that kind; the bank loses, in each kind of water, exactly as many extra rows as the band takes from it there, drawn uniformly from the ball-kept bank rows of that kind
random_rows_control.hard_water_rule: RC.Recorder(spec, physics).in_region on each row's state (the water's push above 0.565); every other row is calm

rng_tags.note: no tag list ends in 0 (numpy drops a trailing 0)

random_rows_control.why_stratified: the band's extra rows are 55-60% hard-water rows (725-924 per seed, stalling world; 49-55% in the no-stall world); a uniform draw took only 154-241 hard-water rows and kept 42.9-45.4% of them against the near-80 setting's 38.5-40.6%, so a band cost would have mixed hiding the 70%-80% commands with thinning the hard-water states

seen_on_seeds_0_4_after_the_rule_was_set.matched_per_stratum: all 10 seed-worlds, training rows and bank

main.role: the main test (version 6, step 2); seeds 0-4 read-only from step 2

random_rows.band: as many random rows as the band removes, in each kind of water

host.name: TD3+BC
host.protocol: step 2's actor-only protocol: frozen fixed-controller critic (100,000 updates, learners.fixed_critic), actor from the cloned actor, alpha 5, 20,000 steps in 4,000-step chunks, the gate's fixed batch stream, one CPU per phase
host.others: not in this version: the co-trained full host and ReBRAC (choice 11 (hosts)); IQL (its actor has no slot for the ramp without a new method version); CQL not offered (no configuration on record)

primary.obca_k1: BCA's switched ramp: step 1's gap rule on the setting's kept commands places the ramp; step 1's certificate (margin 0.10) on held-out scores gives the switch and height; step 2's paired penalty, k = 1

plumbing_check.w0_check: ramp with height 0 and k = 0 must equal the no-caution actor within 1e-5

reported_only_no_test.rule: reported only: no test, no claim, no sentence. Step 2's three attribution tests (its 5-point rule that chose its claim's wording) are not carried over (departure 10)
reported_only_no_test.conformal_k1: plain split conformal switch and height
reported_only_no_test.meandiff_k1: new: plain mean difference above 0.10 as switch, that difference as height

world_blind_rivals.obca_forced: the always-on ramp: BCA's ramp with the switch removed, at the seed's stalling-world BCA height (set from held-out outcomes), in both worlds
world_blind_rivals.standin: range limit matched to the primary arm's strength
world_blind_rivals.note: a world-blind rival is a penalty that cannot turn itself off in either world

reported.version6_bca: version 6's lower edge, weighted width, paired, k = 1; band fitted on the setting's kept rows and bank; reported only (choice 8 (version 6's BCA as a reported arm), default yes)

references.perfect_band: knows the critic's true one-step error
references.knee_ramp: new: BCA's switch and height, ramp starting at the stall, float32(0.8)
references.knee_limit: new: the range limit's penalty with limits at +-0.80 (the stall)
references.full_none: against the full-log critic, from this setting's clone and batches

main_setting.seeds_0_4: step 2's saved actors, read-only, checked by fingerprint, re-evaluated with the 70% hold; tied to the new runner by the reproduction check
main_setting.seeds_10_14: step 2's full arm set if choice 6 (the main setting on seeds 10-14) keeps its default of yes (claim 4, version 8's confirmation); step 2's code refuses every seed but 0-4, so its runner is restated for seeds 10-14 in new code, never edited

arms.matching: blind to returns, to obca_k1's stalling-world strength, version 6's ladders and matcher; no-stall world at the stalling world's locked settings

fixed_references: textbook rule held to 0.70 (the band's lower edge)
textbook rule clipped to each setting's recorded range
best plan within 0.80, 0.70 and 1.0 (first 300 starts per test start set; reported, never in a mark)

situations.note: the four pinned test start sets; nothing recorded there, nothing removed there
situations.name: test start sets (not the calibration bank)

seeds.failed_seed: a fresh seed that fails a data check or a learner fails every mark of claims 1-3; it fails claim 4 only on the gate's own data checks (the five world checks, the ball's leak checks) or a main-setting plumbing stop; never replaced

measures.points: exact 100-step returns on the full test start sets, both worlds, every situation
measures.unseen_throttle_gain: points as trained minus points with every thruster clipped to [-0.70, 0.70] (the band's lower edge) at test
measures.overshoot_loss: points with every thruster clipped to [-0.80, 0.80] (the stall) at test minus points as trained (shift card measure 8)
measures.zone_shares: per situation: share of steps with every thruster below 0.70 (seen), some thruster in [0.70, 0.80] and none past 0.80 (unseen, below the stall), some thruster past 0.80
measures.band_cost: points in the random-rows setting minus points in the near-80 setting, per arm
measures.net_across_worlds: step 2's: gain over none in the stalling world minus loss to none in the no-stall world
measures.certificate: switch, height, 5% bound, ramp ends, group sizes
measures.critic_error_at_band_rows: reported: the frozen critic minus the exact value of the stall-aware controller after the command, at evaluation-split band rows and at the same state with the command clipped to 0.70
measures.version6_width_at_band_rows: reported: version 6's width at the same pairs
measures.removed_share_note: the shift card's removed share is restated for ball or band
measures.lower_tail: mean return of the worst 100 of 1,000 starts
measures.resources: time and peak memory per phase

no_training_checks.when: seeds 0-4 before approval (any failure: no approval asked, redraft); every fresh seed when its data are built (a failure fails that seed for claims 1-3; it fails claim 4 only if the check is the gate's own); check 9 once (fixed test start sets); check 10 on fresh seeds is a validity condition for claims 2 and 3 (at least 4 of 5)
checks: 1 the band is really missing: the leak check passes (no kept training or bank row in the band or the ball; held-out rows untouched); the random-rows control removes the whole ball and exactly the band's number of extra rows in each kind of water, for training rows and bank; before any training phase, each written training file's six arrays have the same SHA-256 as dataset.d4rl_dict of the kept rows (near80lib.training_file_check)
2 the evaluation split keeps at least 300 band rows
3 the band removes 1% to 6% of the ball-kept training rows

4 the gate's five world checks pass on the ball alone; on the near-80 setting full-throttle removal >= 0.99, kept past 80% <= 0.002, identical-rule share >= 0.998, hard-water rows kept >= 0.35 (set after seeing seeds 0-4)
5 at least 10% of the ball-kept hard-water rows are band rows
6 step 1's gap rule is defined in the near-80 and random-rows settings; near-80 lower end in [0.695, 0.70]
7 the calibration bank keeps at least 500 rows
8 with the band empty, the removal reproduces the gate's kept-row and bank hashes
9 fixed test start sets: the stall-aware controller has thruster 1 in the band on >= 50% of strong-current steps, and the textbook rule held to 0.70 loses >= 15 points there
10 per seed, stalling world: the textbook rule clipped to the recorded range loses >= 10 points in strong current when the band is hidden
no_training_checks.seen_on_seeds_0_4: all 117 rules pass on seeds 0-4, both worlds (the review's rerun, and the rerun with the control drawn by kind of water). Seen after the rule was set: check 1's per-kind match of the control; check 6's random-rows gap rule (defined; lower end 0.783-0.791, upper end 0.977-0.998); check 8 (pass on all 10 seed-worlds)
no_training_checks.gap_lo_rule: near-80 lower end in [lo - 0.005, lo], lo = the band's lower edge (any thruster only)

plumbing_after_approval: a 40-step smoke run of every phase (scratch)

with the band empty, bit for bit on seed 0, both worlds: the gate's critic, cloned actor and no-caution actor, and step 2's saved w0_check, obca_k1 and range_hinge_k1 actors (else nothing official starts)
per phase: w0_check within 1e-5, finite parameters, input hashes, the training-file check; a stopped phase is never rerun and fails every mark that needs it

harm.rule: pooled over seeds 0-4, near-80 setting, stalling world, strong current: full-log actor minus none >= 30 points and none past 80% on >= 25% of steps
harm.reason: 30 is twice the largest margin a mark asks (15), so every mark can be met
harm.on_fail: stop the near-80 and random-rows settings before seeds 10-14; report

rival_unaffected.rule: pooled over seeds 0-4: the hand-set range limit's band cost >= 5 points (stalling, strong current)
rival_unaffected.on_fail: stop the near-80 and random-rows settings before seeds 10-14: the band adds nothing to the main test
rival_unaffected.if_no_random_rows_control: if choice 7 (the random-rows control) is set to no: the main setting minus the near-80 setting instead of the band cost

noise_floor.rule: pooled over seeds 0-4, stalling, strong current: |random-rows minus main setting| <= 5 for the hand-set range limit (range_hinge_k1) and obca_k1
noise_floor.reported_only: the no-caution actor's difference (the noisiest arm; claim 3 does not use it)
noise_floor.on_fail: claim 3 is dropped (reported only); nothing else changes
noise_floor.if_no_random_rows_control: if choice 7 (the random-rows control) is set to no: not run

exploratory_stops.not_a_stop: BCA's own marks on seeds 0-4 never stop the fresh seeds (default of choice 9 (after a poor BCA result on seeds 0-4))
exploratory_stops.claim_4: the harm and rival-unaffected stops do not cancel claim 4: the main setting runs on seeds 10-14 whenever choice 6 (the main setting on seeds 10-14) keeps its default

validity_on_seeds_10_14.claims_1_to_3: harm >= 30 and none past 80% on >= 25% of strong-current steps, pooled, near-80 setting
validity_on_seeds_10_14.claims_2_and_3: check 10 holds in >= 4 of 5 fresh seeds
validity_on_seeds_10_14.claim_3_also: the hand-set range limit's band cost >= 5 pooled
validity_on_seeds_10_14.claim_4: nothing from the near-80 setting: only step 2's three marks; a seed fails claim 4 only on the gate's data checks (the five world checks, the ball's leak checks) or a main-setting plumbing stop

pass_marks.pooled: the mean over seeds 10-14 of each seed's paired difference; every seed needed

claim1_bca_holds.net_lead: net across worlds of obca_k1 >= the largest net of the world-blind rivals + 10
claim1_bca_holds.keeps_the_gain: stalling world: obca_k1 minus none >= -3 in recorded conditions, big waves, big kicks
claim1_bca_holds.beats_even_pull: stalling world, strong current: obca_k1 minus the matched even pull >= 15

claim2_unseen_commands.gain: obca_k1's unseen-throttle gain >= 5 pooled and > 0 in >= 4 of 5 seeds (stalling, strong current)
claim2_unseen_commands.overshoot: obca_k1's overshoot loss <= 5 pooled (stalling, strong current)
claim2_unseen_commands.decides: which of four fixed sentences is written
claim2_unseen_commands.power_gain: if a seed's gain varies by 3-6 points: about 85-99% if the true gain is 8, about half if 5
claim2_unseen_commands.power_overshoot: if a seed's overshoot loss varies by 3-6 points: about 87-99% if the true loss is 2, about half if 5, about 1-13% if 8

claim3_band_cost.mark: hand-set range limit's band cost minus obca_k1's band cost >= 5 pooled and > 0 in >= 4 of 5 seeds
claim3_band_cost.power: about 74-85% if the true difference is 8 points, 87-96% if 10, about 45% if 5
claim3_band_cost.droppable: by the noise-floor rule on seeds 0-4
claim3_band_cost.meaning: where full throttle stalls and BCA's switch is on, BCA's ramp is the always-on ramp: two shapes of caution that cannot switch off are compared, a ramp from the data's edge (at BCA's height) and a hard limit at it

claim4_main_setting.source: step 2's three go marks on seeds 10-14 in the main setting
claim4_main_setting.runs_only_if: choice 6 (the main setting on seeds 10-14) keeps its default
claim4_main_setting.separate: its validity needs nothing from the near-80 setting; a seed fails it only on the gate's data checks or a main-setting plumbing stop; the exploratory stops do not cancel it

claims_word_for_word: fixed in PREREGISTRATION.md section 14 (the sentences and the bracket table). The final prereg.json copies them verbatim, and the code manifest it pins lists PREREGISTRATION.md and README.md, so its fingerprint covers this document, as in version 6

compute.unit: CPU-hours (one processor busy for one hour)
compute.confirmatory_seeds_10_14: about 11-15 near-80 and random rows, plus about 6-8.5 for the main setting
compute.machine: Framework Desktop (AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395, 16 cores), Ubuntu 24.04 in WSL with 24 GB, CPU only
compute.memory_rule: version 7's, unchanged: a phase starts only if the reserved peaks of the running phases plus its own are at most WSL's MemTotal minus 8 GiB, and MemAvailable is at least its own reservation plus 8 GiB; an unmeasured phase kind reserves 7 GiB; a measured kind 1.25 x its measured peak; policy phases max(7 GiB, 2 x measured peak). With MemTotal about 23.5 GiB, at most 2 policy phases run at once
compute.wall_time: about 8-11 hours in three sittings (at most 2 policy phases at once under version 7's memory rule; about 11-15 CPU-hours of policy phases)
compute.guard: a stage that uses more than twice its forecast's upper end pauses and reports
compute.version6_for_comparison: estimated at 72-92 process-hours (prereg_v7.json: an estimate that stops nothing)
